title: perf(console): the first load stops downloading the grid and detail packages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1qGnTYLQs3EtmtCmjrcfCe)_
Fixes #33581
Clause-②: yes (widening) — one new published `exports` subpath, `@object-ui/plugin-detail/core`; nothing removed or renamed, the package root exports the same names as before
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:控制台第一次打开任何页面时少下载约 165 KB(压缩后,约为首屏下载量的 8%);首页、仪表盘、列表页、记录页、记录浮层画面和操作都不变。
- 为什么做:控制台首屏提速——过去每个页面都要先下载表格和详情组件,再去读数据。
- 出错会怎样:若某处漏改,表格或详情块第一次出现时会多等一次加载,画面内容不变;本改动可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

On every route the console used to download the `plugin-grid` chunk (all of `@object-ui/plugin-grid` plus 77 `@object-ui/plugin-detail` modules, 183 KB gzip) before its first data read. That chunk now leaves the eager closure; the list and record routes fetch it with their own route chunks, and any other surface fetches it the first time it draws a grid or a detail block.

- **`@object-ui/plugin-detail/core`** (new subpath, ESM only, like the other `/core` subpaths): the pure helpers the console shell needs on every page, registering nothing. Names: `isRefusedFeedRead`, `relatedListEntryNames`, `RELATED_ARRANGEMENT_RECORD_VERSION`, `relatedArrangementFromRecord`, `relatedArrangementToRecord`, `deriveFieldGroupDetailSections`, `deriveHighlightFields`, `resolveDetailSections`, `isWideFieldType`, `prefetchRelatedCounts`, `relatedCountTargetsIn`, `COMPACT_RELATED_ROWS`, `normalizeRelatedListSort`, `seedQueueClaimDecision`, `seedRecordFieldAccess`, `seedRecordVerdict`, type `RelatedArrangement`. The root still exports all of them. `normalizeSortSpec` moved verbatim from `RelatedList.tsx` to `relatedListSort.ts` so the subpath does not reach the component.
- **Published ESM build of plugin-detail**: a second pass (`vite.es.config.ts`) emits `index` and `core` in one pass with `preserveModules`, so the record-page caches the `/core` seeds write are the same module instances the root's hooks read. File names match the package's existing `sideEffects` spellings (`./dist/queueClaim.js` and friends). The UMD build is unchanged.
- **Console shell** (`@object-ui/app-shell`): eight modules take the helpers from `/core`. The record pointer card's key fields and the approval decision's child tables draw `HeaderHighlight` / `RelatedList` through `lazy()` wrappers (`lazyDetailSurfaces.tsx`); the pointer card starts the chunk load beside its record read (no timeout raised). A wrapper mounted after the chunk loaded draws without suspending.
- **Console** (`register-plugins.ts`): the bare `import '@object-ui/plugin-grid'` / `import '@object-ui/plugin-detail'` become `registerLazy` stubs for every tag the two packages register, with the namespaces their registrations declare: `object-grid`, `view:grid`, `detail-view`, `detail-section`, `view:detail`, and the eleven `record:` blocks (`details`, `related_list`, `highlights`, `activity`, `chatter`, `discussion`, `path`, `quick_actions`, `history`, `reference_rail`, `alert`). `App.tsx` loads the dev-only row-actions page lazily. `vite.config.ts` gets a `plugin-detail-core` chunk group so the subpath's closure does not fall into the `plugin-grid` group.

The card's other two slices were already in place on main: `plugin-form` and `plugin-view` were lazy behind their `/core` subpaths (#34176), and `RecordDetailView` / `ObjectView` sat behind the lazy route boundary (#33677). Step 1 below shows it.

### Step 1: main `29556850`, what held each package eager

Eager closure 2,042,500 B gzip, 105 of 2551 chunks. Largest eager chunks: `vendor-objectstack` 673,811 · `ui-components` 351,125 · **`plugin-grid` 183,395** · `index` 135,521 · `framework` 88,559 · `vendor-react` 81,619 · `i18n-locale-en` 66,610 · `vendor-radix` 59,724 · `src` 43,005 · `infrastructure` 37,749.

| Package | Eager on main? | Edges holding it |
|---|---|---|
| plugin-grid (chunk = 74 grid + 77 detail modules) | yes, 183,395 B | `register-plugins.ts` bare imports of grid and detail; `App.tsx` to `dev/DevRowActions.tsx` (ObjectGrid); app-shell named imports from the plugin-detail root in `sharedUserFeeds`, `deriveRelatedLists`, `workspacePreference`, `recordDetailSections`, `recordDrawerStack`, `recordPagePayload`, `SubmittedRecord` (RelatedList), `RecordPreviewCard` (HeaderHighlight) |
| plugin-form | no (only `plugin-form-core`, 6,652 B) | none; lazy since #34176 |
| plugin-view | no (only `plugin-view-core`, 1,789 B) | none; lazy since #34176 |
| RecordDetailView | no | none; behind the lazy route boundary since #33677 |

### Before / after

| Build | Eager gzip bytes | Eager chunks | grid / form / detail / RecordDetailView eager |
|---|---|---|---|
| main `337f435c` | 2,043,450 | 105 | `plugin-grid` 183,666 |
| this branch `feb24f53` (same base) | 1,874,495 (**−168,955**) | 105 | none; `plugin-detail-core` 15,702 joins |
| this branch head `58e12ffd` (main `99fbaa6d` merged) | 1,875,181 | 105 | none (`plugin-detail-core` 15,702, `plugin-form-core` 6,654, `plugin-view-core` 1,789) |

The head row includes main's own drift between the two merges (for example `ui-components` +662 B). `check:eager-closure` on head: exit 0, 1831.2 KB, headroom 600.4 KB.

Lazy chunks, gzip (python gzip -6, main `337f435c` vs head `feb24f53`): `plugin-grid` 183,368 / 188,399 · `plugins-views` 62,376 / 55,420 · `plugin-form` 47,198 / 47,212 · `plugin-view` 19,846 / 19,846 · `RecordDetailView` 29,554 / 30,003. The grid chunk grows by the detail renderers that left `plugins-views`.

## Tests

Local, scoped (CI runs the full suites):
- Before the last main merge, head `feb24f53`: 406 test files (app-shell tests of every touched module, all console `__tests__`, plugin-detail, the `ui/scripts` side-effects and declared-lazy-views tests): 405 passed, 1 failed (`RecordPreviewCard.test.tsx`, the highlight strip under the new lazy wrapper). Fixed in `feb24f53`; that file plus the pins rerun: 13 files / 149 tests passed.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`: exit 0 (on `feb24f53` and again on `58e12ffd`). eslint on the changed files: exit 0. `vitest` over `scripts/`: 5127 tests passed.
- Head `58e12ffd` (after merging main `99fbaa6d`): full turbo build exit 0, eager-closure budget exit 0, type-checks exit 0. The scoped test rerun on this head (493 files) was still running when this body was written (handover cut-off): **NOT MEASURED on `58e12ffd`**, CI is the reading.

Pins: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/pluginCoreSubpaths-33581.test.ts` now also holds `plugin-detail/core` (names, no registrations) and the eager modules (App, register-plugins, the eight shell modules, `lazyDetailSurfaces`) to subpath-or-type-only imports of plugin-detail and plugin-grid.

Ablations (one-shot, on committed head `feb24f53`, each restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob hash compared, `git diff HEAD` empty):
1. `recordPagePayload.ts` back to the plugin-detail root import: all three pin tests red (offender listed, importer floor 8 of 9).
2. bare `import "@object-ui/plugin-grid"` added to `register-plugins.ts`: the bare-import pin red ("bare import from '@object-ui/plugin-grid'"). The first attempt at this ablation was a no-op (the replacement contained the anchor; the replace tool refused it); redone with a different quote spelling.

## Acceptance notes

- Real browser (Chromium, showcase app, signed in as admin; the same server served the `337f435c` console build and then this branch's), five routes: home, a dashboard, an object list, a record page, a record overlay. All five drew on both builds with the same text, no page errors beyond a 404 the home page shows on both, no failed requests.
  - main fetched `plugin-grid` 40–75 ms after navigation on every route, before the first data read (667–1144 ms).
  - this branch: home and dashboard never fetch `plugin-grid`; the list fetches it at 1032 ms beside `ObjectView` (1050); the record page at 882 ms beside `RecordDetailView` (900); the overlay at 1027 ms.
  - JS requests per route (main / head): home 105 / 105, dashboard 143 / 140, list 227 / 201, record 171 / 156, overlay 229 / 203.
- No carve-out naming `plugin-grid` is added to the eager-closure budget check, and none is owed. New gates are "no" by default unless the maintainer names one, and this class is already held by two things: the source pin `pluginCoreSubpaths-33581` (ablation 2 turns it red) and the total `check:eager-closure` budget.
- `plugin-detail-core` (15,702 B gzip at this head) also holds `ConcurrentUpdateDialog`, because `isConcurrentUpdateError` is in the same module. That share of the chunk is not measured on its own.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` — a tag the two packages register but the stubs miss would draw an unresolved component on first use.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/vite.es.config.ts` + `package.json` — the published ESM layout changes to one file per module; the seed caches depend on it.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/lazyDetailSurfaces.tsx` — first-draw loading of the two shell detail components.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console build`, then `node -e 'const j=require("./ui/apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json");console.log(j.eagerGzipBytes, j.files.filter(f=>/^(plugin-|RecordDetailView|plugins-)/.test(f.name)).map(f=>f.name))'` from the repo root. Expected: about 1,875,000, and only `plugin-chatbot-core`, `plugin-detail-core`, `plugin-form-core`, `plugin-view-core`, with no `plugin-grid`.

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 60 families on `f3214b28`; all 60 ran locally and `--ran` reconciled 60 of 60, 0 NOT MEASURED, exit 0. First runs of four families read wrong and were rerun after a full build: dts-closure exit 1 (console `.d.ts` not built yet), dual-build-cjs-loads exit 3 (prerequisite unbuilt), query-options-erasure 124 (my own 300 s timeout), type-check-debt (I stopped its lock-held rebuild); all four reran to exit 0. UI extras: `check:side-effects-array` 0, `check:sdui-registration-pins` 0, `check:eager-closure` 0, `vite-declared-lazy-views` passed inside the builds (13 of 13 lazy). The gate set was not rerun on `58e12ffd` (a clean main merge); the PR check-runs are the reading there.
